title: Zero-Data-Loss Double-Entry Ledger: Designing Idempotency Under High Concurrency
summary: Deep dive into designing bank-grade immutable financial ledgers. How we implemented optimistic locking, deterministic transaction hashing, and transactional outbox patterns to guarantee zero anomalies across 40k+ TPS.

title: Distributed Sagas vs 2-Phase Commit in Real-Time Payment Gateways
summary: Analyzing failure modes when orchestrating multi-party bank settlements. Why choreographic Sagas with compensating actions outshine distributed 2PC across cross-border payment networks, and how to tame partial failures.

title: Taming P99 Tail Latency in Event-Driven Order Matching Engines
summary: Benchmarking lock-free ring buffers (LMAX Disruptor), kernel bypass networking, and zero-allocation memory pools in low-latency transaction routing. Dropping P99 response times from 42ms down to 3.8ms.

title: Kafka Partitioning Strategies for Strict Sequential Account Ordering
summary: How to prevent race conditions in financial ledger account balancing while preserving massive parallel throughput across distributed Kafka clusters with custom keyed partitioners.
